root_idea.summary: The root centers on fineness, compactness, and close joining in a thing.
root_idea.development: This orientation appears in close-set ears, slender or pointed forms, compact joints and plants, and structures with a narrowed or compact upper part. It also develops figuratively into firmness, courage, and acuity of mind, as well as into gathering or making things compact.

qac_form_accounting.reason: The Quran-attested plural is normalized to the singular dictionary citation form صَوْمَعَة.

senses.definition: A high, slender-headed structure; in the Quranic plural صَوَامِع, a Christian monastic cell or monastery.
senses.usage_conditions: The sole Quran occurrence is the plural صَوَامِع. The architectural name is associated with a compact, narrowed, or pointed upper part.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of an ear: small, close-set to the head, and contracted; it may also be described as narrow in its opening or not pointed at the extremity.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to the ears of humans and other animals.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Courage or courageousness, figuratively associated with compactness of heart.
To make a dish of crumbled bread with broth slender in the head and pointed there.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized description of preparing a ثريدة.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A dish of crumbled bread with broth made slender in the head and pointed there.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A descriptive participial expression for a ثريدة.
A conventional architectural use distinct from the monastic-cell sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The uppermost part or body of a dish of crumbled bread with broth, especially when shaped pointed and even.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative or specialized culinary use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A burnus, a garment with a pointed hood; صَوَامِع is also reported for such garments.

other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The designation is explained by the bird's remaining on the highest place to which it can rise.
The designation is explained by the smallness and close-set position of its ear.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Small or slender, even, and smooth at the joints or knots of a limb, shaft, reed, or similar object.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in expressions describing joints of animals and knots or joints of spear-shafts and canes.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a feather: slender in its shaft; also a choice feather suitable for feathering an arrow.
Of a plant or calyx: compact and full-grown or fresh, with its fruit or covering not yet opened.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The descriptions include a plant whose fruit or calyx has not burst open and one that is compact, moist, smooth, round, or slender.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Sharp, vigilant, intelligent, and resolute in mind or judgment.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to the heart, mind, judgment, opinion, or a person characterized by acute intelligence.
This sense is reported with a qualification concerning the reliability of its transmission.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who ascends or rises by degrees to the most elevated places.
Confused or perplexed, unable to see the right course.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Equivalent in meaning to a person described as سَادِرٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The side of the upper part of the neck, or the place of the ear.
